title.value: M-BioBERTa: Modular RoBERTa-based Model for Biobank-scale Unified Representations

TLDR.value: M-BioBERTa, a new transformer-based model for multimodal biobank data, effectively manages missing information and outperforms traditional methods in patient stratification and forecasting disease and drug burdens using the UK Biobank dataset.

abstract.value: Transformers provide a novel approach for unifying large-scale biobank data spread across different modalities and omic domains. We introduce M-BioBERTa, a modular architecture for multimodal data that offers a robust mechanism for managing missing information. We evaluate the model using genetic, demographic, laboratory, diagnostic, and drug prescription data from the UK Biobank, focusing on multimorbidity and polypharmacy related to major depressive disorder. We investigate the harmonized and modular representations in M-BioBERTa for patient stratification. Furthermore, leveraging the learned representations to forecast future disease and drug burdens outperforms traditional machine learning approaches applied directly to the raw data.

primary_area.value: unsupervised, self-supervised, semi-supervised, and supervised representation learning
